market_summary: US100 displays strong bullish momentum holding above its EMA50/VWAP baseline with supportive CVD during London session. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are depressed near daily lows but show positive short-term CVD slope divergence, discouraging fresh breakdown sales. Gold and BTCUSD remain rangebound near key session reference levels.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (POC 4047.00, VAH 4060.33, VAL 4040.95), trading slightly above POC and near VWAP. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.91) with negative slope (-0.25). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is between EMA20 (4052.37) and EMA50 (4051.13) with no volume confirmation (RVOL 0.936). ATR bands are neutral mid-channel. Rejection near 4052.38 resistance keeps bias neutral.

Price is below VAL 1.11417 (POC 1.11657) and below POC/VWAP/EMA50. Session is LONDON_SESSION. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1543) with positive slope (+1365.81) showing divergence against lower prices. RVOL is 0.742 (no yellow volume spike on current breakdown). Price is holding near 24h/Session Low (1.11307) and lower ATR band (1.11334). Divergent CVD slope and lack of fresh RVOL expansion warrant waiting for a retest.

Price is below VAL 1.33210 and below POC 1.33476. Session is LONDON_SESSION. CVD is NEUTRAL (-874) with a positive slope (+422.44), showing buying absorption/divergence as price tests Session Low 1.33089. RVOL is 1.164 without a >2.0 spike on the low test. Price sits right on the lower ATR band 1.33117. Due to CVD slope divergence into support, immediate shorting is unsafe.
signals.level_event: test of Session Low 1.33089 and Prev Low 1.33119

signals.rationale: Price is inside top of Value Area / near VAH 28280.99 (POC 28117.47, VAL 28017.25) and firmly above VWAP and EMA50 baseline. Session is LONDON_SESSION. CVD is BULLISH (+8.96) confirming upward pressure. RVOL on US100 CFD is normal (0.922), applying the US100 caveat. Price is riding near the upper ATR band (28278.85) approaching Session High 28280.99. Strong structural uptrend confirmed across session.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish well above VWAP 28088.77 and EMA50 28088.45

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH 73828.35 (POC 73660.40) and above VWAP/EMA50. Session is LONDON_SESSION. CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) presenting a slight bearish divergence at the highs. RVOL is 1.078 with no yellow spike. Candle wicks near 73975.30 S/R and Session High 74085.20 show rejection mid-channel relative to upper ATR (74199.47). Divergent CVD and upper resistance recommend holding.
